title: Suzana
category: Brand identity • Brand guidelines • Packaging applications
description: A visual identity presentation for Suzana bags and accessories. A flowing S and floral motif appear across logo variants, colour and type rules, stationery, gift packaging and shopping-bag mockups.
challenge: Give the identity a consistent presence across small logo uses and more expressive packaging presentations.
solution: A dark teal base supports plum and pink accents. The floral S, fine borders and restrained typography carry through the mockups.
results: An identity and application study. Packaging images are presentation mockups, not evidence of manufactured products.
